The White House is threatening Democrats in Congress, warning them that investigating President Donald Trump could cross the line into criminal action.

Punchbowl News [reports](https://punchbowl.news/wh-hill_letter/?utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11/11/26%20AM:&utm_term=%28prod%29%20AM%20Subscribers) that White House counsel Will Scharf sent a letter on Monday to Democratic Representative Robert Garcia, the incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, saying that congressional investigations “must further a legitimate executive task; Congress cannot employ them to exercise powers of criminal prosecution assigned to the Executive and the Judiciary.”

Garcia and his fellow Democrats have made “it abundantly clear that any forthcoming investigative processes will be deployed to harass and aggrandize, rather than to advance any legitimate legislative end,” Scharf claims, citing statements by incoming Democrats calling for the prosecution of ICE agents, trials for tech executives, and hearings for Cabinet secretaries like embattled Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

The letter is an extreme attempt to intimidate House Democrats into backing off Trump and his legally questionable actions, and it makes a mockery of the constitutional separation of powers, as well as checks and balances between the three branches of government. Scharf is taking a questionable Republican position that effectively says that Congress has no critical oversight over the executive branch.

The warning is rich, considering how the Trump administration has pushed sham prosecutions against members of Congress who told military and intelligence personnel not to follow [illegal orders](https://newrepublic.com/post/206952/donald-trump-drops-case-democrats-message-troops) or who protested [against ICE](https://newrepublic.com/post/212280/trump-puts-pregnant-dem-congresswoman-trial-ice-oversight). That’s to say nothing of the targeting of [many](https://newrepublic.com/post/205187/donald-trump-targets-letitia-james-again) of Trump’s perceived [enemies](https://newrepublic.com/article/217108/trump-vile-prosecution-ilhan-omar-run-wall). It seems that the White House knows it has something to hide and thinks of itself as above the law.
